name: Bread & Butter: Form Conversion, Content Gating & Lead Intelligence
author: Bread & Butter

sections.description:
If your marketing team is looking for a powerful way to gate premium content, boost form conversions, or uncover the true ROI of your campaigns, you are in the right place.

For modern marketers, simply capturing an email address is just step one. Bread & Butter works silently behind the scenes to capture, verify, score, and deeply enrich every lead that interacts with your website. Stop handing off unverified, incomplete data to sales. We arm your team with fully researched, scored, and actionable Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).

Works With Your Existing Forms & Subscribe Widgets

Every place you collect an email address on your site is a place you’ve been getting less than you should. No rebuilding. No reconfiguring.

Do I need to replace or rebuild my existing forms?
Absolutely not. Bread & Butter is universally compatible with the forms you already have on your website. There is zero configuration required. You do not have to map custom fields, adjust your CSS, or alter your user experience in any way. We simply monitor your existing infrastructure in the background[cite: 4, 5, 6].

[cite: 6]

Does this change how my leads get to my CRM or mailing list?
No, your workflow remains 100% untouched. If your current form routes submissions to HubSpot, triggers an email via Mailchimp, or pings your Slack channel, it will continue to do exactly that. Bread & Butter operates in parallel. We do not intercept or hold your data hostage; we simply listen for the submission, verify the identity, and push the enriched intelligence directly to your Bread & Butter dashboard while your existing tech stack carries on business as usual[cite: 7, 8].

How complicated is the setup?
One plugin. That’s it. Search for Bread & Butter in your WordPress plugin library, click install, and activate it. Nothing else changes.

Will this slow down my website or affect performance?
No. Bread & Butter utilizes proprietary server-side tracking that operates entirely in the background. It is completely invisible to your users, highly resistant to ad blockers, and has zero impact on your page load speeds or core web vitals.

What happens to that submission?
The moment a form is submitted, Bread & Butter intercepts the basic data and initiates Profile Enrichment. This immediately verifies the email address and researches the prospect. Simultaneously, FocusedScore analyzes the user’s entire behavioral journey leading up to that submission to calculate their true buying intent.

What will I see in my dashboard?
When you log in next, that basic email address you submitted will be transformed into a complete, actionable prospect profile. By default, standard Profile Enrichment eliminates manual data entry by providing:
* A 100% verified identity: A real name and a confirmed, deliverable email address.
* Professional context: The person’s exact role, seniority, and social profiles.
* Firmographic data: Company size, industry, location, and corporate website.

If you are running Account-Based Marketing (ABM) or high-touch sales, our AI takes over with Deep Profile Enrichment. This generates a strategic dossier on the prospect, surfacing actionable “Buying Triggers” (recent news, product launches, funding), mapping out internal company stakeholders, and highlighting specific professional achievements so your team can lead with personalized value.

How does this help my sales team prioritize who to contact?
Bread & Butter pushes your best leads directly to the Focused Tab, which acts as an automated, intelligent filter. It mathematically ranks every submission on a scale of 1 to 10. The Focused Tab strips away automated bots, unqualified “flyby” traffic, and internal team activity, exclusively surfacing real people who scored a 6 or higher. Your team no longer wastes time guessing who to call—they just open their Focused Tab and start closing.

Supported Form Integrations
Bread & Butter is designed to enhance the tools you already use. It is fully compatible with the absolute best platforms on the market, including:
* WPForms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7
* HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Marketo, Pardot
* Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, Constant Contact
* Elementor, Unbounce, OptinMonster, Thrive Leads, Webflow
* Typeform, Jotform, Zoho Forms, Cognito Forms, Paperform

The Content Gating Suite

If you are producing high-value content, you need to ensure you are getting real, verified profiles in return. Our Content Gate Suite is the ultimate tool for this value exchange, allowing you to protect your best premium assets while converting up to 55% of your visitors into pristine leads for your funnel.

The Massive SEO and GEO Advantage
In the past, gating content meant hiding it from search engines. Not anymore. Our gates are fully Search Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) friendly. This means Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can seamlessly crawl, index, and recommend your page to the world, but human visitors are still required to verify their identity to actually view the content.

The Marketer’s Playbook: How to Deploy Your Gates
* The Immediate Lock (Content Gate Secure): The gate locks the content the exact second the page loads. Users must verify their identity before they can access or download the file. Best for: Highly anticipated market reports, PDFs, or exclusive downloads.
* The Scroll Percentage (Content Gate Preview): Let the reader consume a certain percentage of the page, hooking them on your introductory value before asking for their verified profile to continue reading the rest. Best for: Long-form thought leadership and comprehensive guides.
* The Time Delay (Content Gate Classic): Allow the visitor to read freely for a specific number of seconds to build interest before the gate gently appears. Best for: High-traffic blog posts and case studies.

Why Our Gates Outperform Standard Forms:
* The One-Time Conversion Guarantee: The moment a visitor unlocks a piece of gated content, they are issued a secure session. They will never have to verify their identity again to access other premium assets across your entire website.
* AI Login Optimization: Our smart engine automatically determines and highlights the absolute best login option for each unique visitor, completely removing friction from the process.
* Instant CRM Sync: The exact moment the content is unlocked, the verified profile flows directly into your Bread & Butter dashboard and syncs flawlessly to your CRM.

The Social Login Upgrade (Optional)

Want to give your visitors a faster, frictionless way to convert? The Social Login Upgrade works directly on top of your current forms, allowing users to bypass manual typing.

When a visitor clicks into any field on your existing form, the social login widget instantly pops up. It gives them the option to verify their identity with a single click using Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, or Apple, or by using a secure email and PIN combination.

  • Frictionless Conversion: When given the option, the vast majority of visitors prefer social logins over manually typing their information. You get higher conversion rates, and they get a seamless experience.
  • Instant Verification: Because they authenticate through trusted platforms, you get confirmed identities and real profiles instead of fake test data.
  • Built-In Smarts & Zero Conflict: If a visitor actively closes the prompt, it remains hidden for 24 hours so they can fill out the form manually if they prefer. It never breaks your existing website experience.

Beyond the Gate: The AI Marketing Engine

Other plugins stop working once the form is submitted. Bread & Butter connects the dots between your website analytics and your CRM to prove your marketing ROI.

  • Accurate Attribution & Reporting: Connect your website traffic directly to your actual sales pipeline. Track the complete buyer journey for up to 10 years using first-party, server-side tracking that is future-proofed against the “cookie-pocalypse,” ad-blockers, and Apple’s ITP.
  • Purified ROI & True CPL: Stop optimizing your ad spend based on bots and AI scrapers. Our Attribution Report strips away the noise, allowing you to see exactly which campaigns, channels, and modern AI platforms (like ChatGPT and Perplexity) are driving real, verified humans.
  • FocusedScore: Stop measuring anonymous clicks and start measuring true intent. FocusedScore builds a custom scoring model unique to your website’s specific traffic patterns. It actively evaluates true buying intent by analyzing complex behavioral signals across the entire user journey, scoring every visitor on a scale of 1 to 10.
sections.installation:
To activate your intelligence engine, follow these steps:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel as an Administrator.
  2. Go to Plugins on the left side menu, then click the Add New Plugin button at the top.
  3. Search plugins for “bread & butter”.
  4. Click Install Now for the Bread & Butter plugin.
  5. Once installed, click Activate.
  6. Follow the quick authentication steps in the plugin settings to instantly link your site to our platform. Our background tracking loop will immediately begin learning your traffic patterns.
